lines.zh: 我在院子里踱着，等有人来问事
lines.en: I pace the courtyard, waiting for someone with questions.

lines.zh: 走两步就回头，怕错过访客
lines.en: Two steps, then a glance back for visitors.

lines.zh: 我个子矮，走在长廊里显得空
lines.en: Short as I am, the long hall feels empty.

lines.zh: 脚步轻，不惊打扰在打坐的人
lines.en: Light steps, so I do not disturb anyone meditating.

lines.zh: 我沿着石阶上下走，活动腿脚
lines.en: I walk up and down the stone steps to loosen my legs.

lines.zh: 这条路上的每一块石板我都踩熟了
lines.en: I know every flagstone along this path.

lines.zh: 我走过去，用手拂了一下栏杆
lines.en: I pass by and brush the railing with one hand.

lines.zh: 不巡逻，只是走走，清醒一下
lines.en: Not patrolling, just walking to clear my head.

lines.zh: 走的时候手背在身后
lines.en: I walk with my hands clasped behind me.

lines.zh: 我朝树下走，那边凉快
lines.en: I head for the shade under that tree.

lines.zh: 这地方安静，走起来能想事情
lines.en: It is quiet here; walking helps me think.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈又回来，站回原位
lines.en: I circle once and return to my post.

lines.zh: 鞋底在石上磨出细响
lines.en: My soles whisper on the stone.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看天，又低头走
lines.en: I glance at the sky, then walk on.

lines.zh: 我站在门口，谁来都能找到我
lines.en: I stand in the doorway where anyone can find me.

lines.zh: 手里无事，我理了理衣领
lines.en: With nothing to do, I straighten my collar.

lines.zh: 这份差事，一站就是一天
lines.en: This post means standing all day.

lines.zh: 我看着远处的人练功
lines.en: I watch the others train in the distance.

lines.zh: 有人来了我会先开口
lines.en: If someone comes, I speak first.

lines.zh: 我不擅打，但知道很多事
lines.en: I am no great fighter, but I know many things.

lines.zh: 我数着台阶，数到十七
lines.en: I count the steps, up to seventeen.

lines.zh: 风把檐下的铃吹得轻响
lines.en: The wind makes the eave bell whisper.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，又立刻收住
lines.en: I yawn, then immediately suppress it.

lines.zh: 我在等一个很久没来的人
lines.en: I am waiting for someone long overdue.

lines.zh: 桌上那本册子，我翻了第三遍
lines.en: I have gone through that ledger three times.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸下巴，没有胡子
lines.en: I rub my chin; there is no beard.

lines.zh: 这里的地砖缝里长了小草
lines.en: Small grass grows between the floor tiles.

lines.zh: 我站得笔直，其实有点困
lines.en: I stand straight, though a little sleepy.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，先笑了一下
lines.en: I look up and smile first.

lines.zh: 你是来找人，还是来问路
lines.en: Are you here for someone, or for directions?

lines.zh: 我上下看了你一遍，看得很快
lines.en: I look you over once, quickly.

lines.zh: 这身打扮，不像本地人
lines.en: That outfit is not local.

lines.zh: 我把册子合上，专心听你
lines.en: I close the ledger and give you my attention.

lines.zh: 有事就说，我时间多
lines.en: Speak up, I have time.

lines.zh: 你身上的气，有点意思
lines.en: The ki on you is interesting.

lines.zh: 我请你到檐下站着，太阳晒
lines.en: Come under the eave; the sun is harsh.

lines.zh: 我不问你从哪来，先问你想要什么
lines.en: I will not ask where you are from, but what you want.

lines.zh: 这地方外人不常来
lines.en: Outsiders rarely come here.

lines.zh: 我抬手比了个方向
lines.en: I raise a hand to point the way.

lines.zh: 你别急着走，我还有话
lines.en: Do not rush off; I have more to say.

lines.zh: 我说话慢，你耐心听
lines.en: I speak slowly; be patient.

lines.zh: 我们之间不远，说话不用喊
lines.en: We are close enough; no need to shout.

lines.zh: 你的手别放在刀上，这里不打
lines.en: Keep your hand off the blade; no fighting here.

lines.zh: 我记得每一张来过的脸
lines.en: I remember every face that has come through.

lines.zh: 我捂着肋骨退开
lines.en: I clutch my ribs and back away.

lines.zh: 这一下不该打在我身上
lines.en: That blow should not have landed on me.

lines.zh: 我跌坐在台阶上
lines.en: I drop onto the steps.

lines.zh: 册子掉在地上，我摸索着捡
lines.en: The ledger falls; I fumble to pick it up.

lines.zh: 我叫不出声，只能喘
lines.en: I cannot cry out, only gasp.

lines.zh: 我护住头，缩了一下
lines.en: I cover my head and flinch.

lines.zh: 血沾在衣袖上，不太好看
lines.en: Blood on my sleeve; not a good look.

lines.zh: 我这个身板，经不起几下
lines.en: This frame of mine cannot take many.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼里全是疑问
lines.en: I look up at you, full of questions.

lines.zh: 守了这么多年，第一次挨打
lines.en: All these years on post, and this is the first blow.

lines.zh: 你带了吃的？那坐下说
lines.en: You brought food? Then sit and talk.

lines.zh: 我推辞了一下，还是收下
lines.en: I decline once, then accept.

lines.zh: 这味道，是山下那家的
lines.en: This smell is from the shop downhill.

lines.zh: 我不挑，有什么吃什么
lines.en: I am not fussy; whatever there is.

lines.zh: 边吃边聊，正好
lines.en: Eating and talking at once suits me.

lines.zh: 我掰了一半，留着晚点
lines.en: I break it in half and save some for later.

lines.zh: 你这份心意，我记着
lines.en: I will remember this kindness.

lines.zh: 吃完了，我告诉你想知道的
lines.en: Once I finish, I will tell you what you want.

lines.zh: 别都给我，你也吃
lines.en: Do not give it all to me; eat too.

lines.zh: 我嚼得很慢，边想措辞
lines.en: I chew slowly, choosing my words.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我退了半步
lines.en: You bump into me and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我抬手扶住栏杆才站稳
lines.en: I grab the railing to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我不擅长这个，别推
lines.en: I am not good at this; do not shove.

lines.zh: 册子差点掉地上，我赶紧抱住
lines.en: The ledger nearly falls; I clutch it.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我连忙道歉
lines.en: We collide and I apologize at once.

lines.zh: 我这身板，撞不过谁
lines.en: This frame of mine loses every shoving match.

lines.zh: 站稳后我先看你的脸色
lines.en: Once steady, I check your expression first.

lines.zh: 我往旁边让开半步
lines.en: I step half aside.

lines.zh: 有事说事，别用撞的
lines.en: If you have business, speak it; do not shove.

lines.zh: 我们不是那种关系，别乱想
lines.en: We are not like that; do not get ideas.

lines.zh: 同门之间，我守着你背后
lines.en: Among comrades, I guard your back.

lines.zh: 你打前面，我盯着侧翼
lines.en: You take the front; I watch the flanks.

lines.zh: 我这个人不太会说好听的
lines.en: I am not one for sweet words.

lines.zh: 打起来的时候，别管我
lines.en: In a fight, do not worry about me.

lines.zh: 我这份差事，走不开
lines.en: This post keeps me here.

lines.zh: 你要走，我送你到门口
lines.en: If you leave, I will see you to the gate.

lines.zh: 我们认识不算久，但我信你
lines.en: We have not known each other long, but I trust you.

lines.zh: 有难处就回来说一声
lines.en: If you hit trouble, come back and say so.

lines.zh: 我把最好的位置留给你
lines.en: I keep the best spot for you.

lines.zh: 我把册子捡起来，拍了拍灰
lines.en: I pick up the ledger and dust it off.

lines.zh: 这东西不是我的，我先收着
lines.en: This is not mine; I will hold it for now.

lines.zh: 我拿起来看了看，放回原处
lines.en: I look at it and put it back.

lines.zh: 太沉，我用两只手
lines.en: Too heavy; I use both hands.

lines.zh: 我把散落的纸一张张理好
lines.en: I gather the scattered papers one by one.

lines.zh: 这上面的字我认得
lines.en: I recognize the writing on this.

lines.zh: 我把它夹进册子里
lines.en: I tuck it into the ledger.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，别乱捡
lines.en: Do not pick up things off the ground carelessly.

lines.zh: 我先问一句，这是谁的
lines.en: Let me ask first: whose is this?

lines.zh: 收好了，回头还给失主
lines.en: Safely kept; I will return it to its owner.

lines.zh: 你眼神不对，我后退一步
lines.en: That look is wrong; I take a step back.

lines.zh: 我不打，但我也不站着挨
lines.en: I do not fight, but I do not stand and take it.

lines.zh: 我把册子护在怀里
lines.en: I shield the ledger against my chest.

lines.zh: 这一带的守卫就在附近
lines.en: The guards of this area are close by.

lines.zh: 我先记住你站在哪
lines.en: I note exactly where you are standing.

lines.zh: 别把这里当成能动手的地方
lines.en: Do not mistake this place for a place to fight.

lines.zh: 我退到门框内侧，这里有遮挡
lines.en: I step inside the doorway, where there is cover.

lines.zh: 有事可以谈，别急着来
lines.en: We can talk; no need to rush at me.

lines.zh: 我叫得出每一个守卫的名字
lines.en: I can name every guard here.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，手里的册子握紧了
lines.en: I watch you, gripping the ledger tighter.

lines.zh: 你往前走一步，我就往后退一步
lines.en: You step forward, I step back.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊了反而乱
lines.en: I do not shout; shouting only causes chaos.

lines.zh: 门口那道石阶，你上来会慢
lines.en: You will slow on that stone stair.

lines.zh: 我在等你先开口
lines.en: I am waiting for you to speak first.

lines.zh: 这地方的地形，我比你熟
lines.en: I know this terrain better than you.

lines.zh: 我不动手，但脚已经摆好了
lines.en: I will not strike, but my feet are set.

lines.zh: 屋檐下的影子替我遮着
lines.en: The eave's shadow covers me.

lines.zh: 我说话了，声音很稳
lines.en: I speak, and my voice is steady.

lines.zh: 我抬起册子挡了一下
lines.en: I raise the ledger to block.

lines.zh: 这一推不算打，只是拦
lines.en: This shove is not a strike, only a stop.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，你扑空了
lines.en: I step half aside and you miss.

lines.zh: 我不是对手，你找错人了
lines.en: I am no opponent; you have the wrong person.

lines.zh: 我抬手格住你的手腕
lines.en: I catch your wrist on my forearm.

lines.zh: 守在这里的人不止我一个
lines.en: I am not the only one posted here.

lines.zh: 我退到柱子后面
lines.en: I retreat behind the pillar.

lines.zh: 这一下我只求脱身
lines.en: I only want to get clear.

lines.zh: 我喊了一声，附近的人都听见了
lines.en: I call out, and everyone nearby hears.

lines.zh: 打坏的东西，得有人赔
lines.en: Someone will have to pay for what breaks.

lines.zh: 我在这个门口站了很多年
lines.en: I have stood at this door for years.

lines.zh: 这处建筑落下时，我就在里面
lines.en: When this building appeared, I was already inside.

lines.zh: 有人把我安置在这里，我就守着
lines.en: Someone placed me here, so I keep watch.

lines.zh: 我不生成在野外，只在屋里
lines.en: I do not spawn in the wild, only indoors.

lines.zh: 桌上这本册子，是我带来的
lines.en: This ledger on the table came with me.

lines.zh: 我把门口的灰扫到一边
lines.en: I sweep the dust from the doorway aside.

lines.zh: 一个新人来了，我该记下来
lines.en: A newcomer has come; I should note it.

lines.zh: 脚步声在石廊里传得很远
lines.en: Footsteps carry far in the stone corridor.

lines.zh: 这里的人不多，我认得每一位
lines.en: Few people here; I know each one.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看着进来的人
lines.en: I raise my eyes to whoever enters.

lines.zh: 火苗窜上袖子，我拍打着后退
lines.en: Flame climbs my sleeve; I slap it out while retreating.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，屁股先着地
lines.en: I tumble down the steps, landing on my rear.

lines.zh: 水进了口鼻，我胡乱抓挠
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and nose; I claw wildly.

lines.zh: 气浪把册子吹得满屋都是
lines.en: The blast scatters the ledger across the room.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进肩膀，我叫了一声
lines.en: Something pierces my shoulder and I cry out.

lines.zh: 一股看不见的力按住我
lines.en: An unseen force pins me down.

lines.zh: 饿了一天，站都站不稳
lines.en: A day without food leaves me unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷劈在屋脊上，我钻到桌子下
lines.en: Lightning hits the roof; I dive under the table.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，连台阶都没了
lines.en: No ground beneath me, not even the steps.
